examples.pie: kʷós deynos dweh₂rós h₁ésti pr̥h₂wós dinós dweh₂rós h₁ésti.
examples.en: Which day is long? The first day is long.

examples.en: Whose head is long?

examples.pie: yóh₁r̥ dweh₂róm h₁ésti.
examples.en: The year is long.

examples.pie: nu h₂ékʷeh₂es h₂ówins h₂élete h₂léksete-kʷe nos.
examples.en: Now, Waters, you nourish the sheep, and you protect us.

examples.pie: h₁yós kéh₂ikom h₂élēti péḱos tósmey h₁opéyētor.
examples.en: Whoever feeds the blind, wealth shall be given to him.

examples.pie: ǵr̥h₂nóm me h₂életi mélit-kʷe te h₂életi.

examples.pie: tósyo h₃bʰrúHs dʰégʷʰet ḱéh₂dos-kʷe h₁nédʰt.
examples.en: His eyebrow burned, and hatred came forth.

examples.en: Whoever burns an eyebrow, let him give a gift.

examples.pie: h₃bʰrúHs méntim woydéyeti.

examples.pie: kúdʰe ph₂ter gʷṓs h₂éǵesi? súHnew h₁íns h₂éǵrom h₂éǵoh₂. h₂én h₁édn̥ti wódr̥-kʷe píph₃onti. h₁íns h₂éǵōh₂. ḱód ḱéntrom kapyé h₁íns-kʷe sékʷeso. h₁íns mē stunéds. h₁íns ne stunédoh₂ h₁íns wédʰōh₂.
examples.en: Father, where are you driving the cattle? I am driving them to the pasture, son. There they eat and drink water. Let me drive them! Hold this goad and follow them. Do not beat them! I shall not beat them; I shall lead them.

examples.pie: uksénes moy gʷr̥déwes. h₂eḱróm ḱéntrom wéḱmi. h₁íd h₂éyesos tétḱoh₂ ḱr̥h₂nṓd-wē tétḱoh₂? ḱr̥h₂nṓd. h₂éyos polh₁ú h₂élgʷʰeti. h₁l̥ḱéys moy ḱr̥h₂nóm widé. ne gʰrémōnti? gʰrémōnti. HéHḱyos stéygʰōnti.
examples.en: My oxen are slow. I want a sharp pointed tool. Shall I make it from bronze or from horn? From horn. Bronze costs much. Find me the horn of an elk. Will they not become angry? They will become angry. They will walk more swiftly.

examples.pie: ḱḗr mē tréms deywós te péh₂sti. kʷsép l̥gʰdʰí h₂éwsōs h₁ludʰḗti ḱḗr Hwr̥dʰdʰí.
examples.en: Heart, do not tremble. A god protects you. Night, lie down. Dawn will come. Heart, become strong.

examples.pie: sóh₂wl̥ dʰéǵʰōm lowkéyeti. lówksneh₂ kʷsépm̥ lowkéyeti.
examples.en: The sun lights up the earth. The moon lights up the night.

examples.pie: nékʷti ne swépm̥. kʷíd bʰéwdʰes? trḗm. príHe mē tréms. ḱwṓ nos stégos kʷsépi h₂lékseti.
examples.en: I did not fall asleep in the night. Why were you awake? I was trembling. Do not tremble, friend! Our dog guards the house at night.

examples.pie: h₁yód h₂nḗr déh₂newi h₃méyǵʰēti déywih₂ tóm gʷʰn̥sḱétu. h₁yós sruméni h₃méyǵʰēti h₂ékʷeh₂es tóm stundéntu. h₁yós múHtrom bʰr̥h₁wéni logʰéyēti só h₂éǵrōd h₂epó léyttu.
examples.en: If a man urinates in the river, let the goddess strike him. Whoever urinates in the stream, let the waters hit him. Whoever puts filth into the spring, let him go away from the field.

examples.pie: kʷís ph₂wéns ǵn̥h₁yétor ḱóymōd-kʷe úd h₁éyti? h₁ím kʷis ǵʰóstoh₁ ne kapyéti. dʰuh₂mós.
examples.en: Who is born of fire and goes up from the home? No one holds him in the hand. Smoke.

examples.pie: h₁yód dʰuh₂mós h₁ésti péh₂wr̥ h₁ésti. dʰuh₂mós ḱóymōd úd gʷm̥sḱéti. péh₂wr̥ ne ḱéletor.
examples.en: If there is smoke, there is fire. Smoke comes up from the home. Fire does not hide itself.

examples.pie: h₁yós péh₂wr̥ ne péh₂sti h₁opéyēti só h₁éh₁ugʰos.
examples.en: Whoever does not guard the fire shall give a vow.

examples.pie: nu swésōr yéh₁ni h₁r̥sḱét. h₂éǵt kʷis. swésor h₂wéks. téwe h₁nómn̥ ḱlutóm.

examples.pie: h₁yód gʰóstis némos gʷm̥yḗti tósmey sédos bʰoh₂góm-kʷe dh₃dʰí. h₁ésmey mā́dsom kʷérōd dedh₃dʰí. h₁yós gʰóstim h₂epó h₂éǵēti bʰágos tóm mē ḱluyéh₁t.
examples.en: If a guest comes to the sacrifice, give him a seat and a share. Give him food from the cauldron. Whoever drives away a guest, may Bhagos not hear him.

examples.pie: méh₂ter h₂wést. gʷṓs h₂mélǵoh₂? dʰúgh₂ter h₁íns h₂ml̥ǵdʰí h₂mélǵos-kʷe dṓm h₁n̥dó wédʰe. kúdʰe kʷéros h₁ésti? h₂Hséh₂i légʰeti. ḱeḱómh₂th₂e? ne ḱeḱómh₂h₂e. kénkoh₂. nu mā́dsom h₂mélǵesh₁ h₁ddʰí.
examples.en: Mother, it has grown light. Shall I milk the cows? Milk them, daughter, and bring the milk into the house. Where is the pot? It lies at the hearth. Are you tired? I am not tired. I am hungry. Then eat mush with milk.

examples.pie: nu nos h₂Hséh₂s h₁ń̥gʷney démi sedéh₁yesi. h₂ŕ̥ǵre ǵérh₂ontn̥s téḱneh₂-kʷe gʷʰr̥néwsi. mā́dsom nos pékʷesi nékʷti nos péh₂si. h₃éngʷn̥ toy h₂sowsóm-kʷe dóru dedh₃més. mē mérs léwke h₂éydʰe h₂ŕ̥ǵre.
examples.en: Now, Fire of the hearth, you sit in our house. You heat the old men and the children, shining one. You cook our food; in the night you guard us. We give you butter and dry wood. Do not die, bright fire, shining one!

examples.pie: ǵénh₁tri moy h₂wl̥péys spélom wéwke. h₂wĺ̥pis ḱóymom nékʷti gʷémt. h₂ówins widét. nu kʷíd dʰéh₁t? h₁íh₂n̥s gʷr̥h₃ét. nu l̥gʰdʰí. h₂wl̥péys dedwóyh₂e. mē bʰéyh₂s. h₂wĺ̥pis medtéh₂.
examples.en: Mother, tell me a story about the fox. The fox came to the village at night. She saw the sheep. What did she do then? She devoured them. Now lie down. I am afraid of the fox. Do not be afraid. The fox is full.
